A medium shot features a middle-aged woman with fair skin and long, light blonde and graying hair parted in the center. She wears clear-framed glasses and looks directly at the camera with a neutral expression. Her eyebrows are thin and light, and she has muted red lipstick on. She is dressed in a blue and white plaid button-down shirt over a dark top, and a delicate dark necklace adorns her neck. A small earring is visible in her left ear.

She is seated behind a wooden desk. On the desk is a closed black laptop with a silver logo, an open notebook with lined pages, a black pen, a green apple, and a red and green apple. To her right is a glass containing a light brown liquid and a black microphone on a stand.

The background consists of a white wall and a wooden bookshelf filled with books of varying colors and sizes. The top shelf of the bookshelf holds a yellow pear-shaped object and a green leafy plant in a brown pot. The lighting in the scene appears soft and natural.
